description: Understand what is AI, its applications and use cases, its ethical considerrations and how it is transforming our lives, including What is AI? Applications, Examples of AI, AI: Issues, Concerns, Ethical Considerations.

Explore common generative AI models and tools for text, code, image, audio, and video generation, including Generative AI: Introduction, Applications, Introduction and capacities of Generative AI, Application and tools of Generative AI.

Explore commonly used tools for prompt engineering to aid with prompt engineering, including Generative AI: Prompt Engineering Basics, Prompt Engineering for Generative AI, Prompt Engineering: Techniques, Approaches.
Visually create and deploy chatbots with Watson Assistant, including intents, entities, dialog design, deployment, context variables, slots, digressions, and optional Watson Actions concepts.
Explain underlying concepts related to Machine Learning, Deep Learning and Neural Networks, including AI Concepts, Terminology, Application Areas, AI: Issues, Concerns, Ethical Considerations.
